nodes.Name: EdgeKind
nodes.DocComment: EdgeKind classifies what a directed edge means.

nodes.Name: ObjectNode
nodes.DocComment: ObjectNode is one symbol in the graph.

nodes.Name: ObjectEdge
nodes.DocComment: ObjectEdge is a directed relationship between two nodes.

nodes.Name: ObjectGraph
nodes.DocComment: ObjectGraph is the full project graph.

nodes.Name: BuildOptions
nodes.DocComment: BuildOptions controls how the graph is constructed.

nodes.Name: DefaultBuildOptions
nodes.DocComment: DefaultBuildOptions are calibrated for AI prompt use.

nodes.Name: Build
nodes.DocComment:
Build constructs an ObjectGraph from the symbol index and optional flow data.
effects may be nil if flow analysis has not been run.

nodes.Name: Render
nodes.DocComment:
Render produces a compact text representation of the graph for
inclusion in LLM prompts. Format:

	GRAPH  <project_root>  nodes:<N>  edges:<E>

	LAYER handler
	  pkg/handler.go#func:CreateUser → handler.CreateUser(req:CreateUserRequest) error
	  ...

	CALLS
	  CreateUser → validate,userRepo.Save
	  ...

nodes.Name: Save
nodes.DocComment: Save writes the graph to a JSON file at path.

nodes.Name: Load
nodes.DocComment:
Load reads a previously saved ObjectGraph from path.
Returns an empty graph if the file does not exist.

nodes.Name: DefaultPath
nodes.DocComment: DefaultPath is the conventional location for the object graph file.

nodes.Name: NodesInLayer
nodes.DocComment: NodesInLayer returns all nodes assigned to the given architectural layer.

nodes.Name: CalleesOf
nodes.DocComment: CalleesOf returns the IDs of all nodes directly called by nodeID.

nodes.Name: CallersOf
nodes.DocComment: CallersOf returns the IDs of all nodes that call nodeID.

nodes.Name: NodeByID
nodes.DocComment: NodeByID returns the node with the given ID, or nil.

nodes.Name: effectsForSymbol
nodes.DocComment: effectsForSymbol extracts effect kind strings for a symbol ID.

nodes.Name: nitForSymbol
nodes.DocComment: nitForSymbol produces a one-line NIT summary of a symbol for the graph.

nodes.Name: SkillContext
nodes.DocComment:
SkillContext builds the compact string that replaces a .md skill file
for one architectural layer. It combines the layer's NIT signatures
with the call-edge summary.

nodes.Name: TokenEstimate
nodes.DocComment:
TokenEstimate returns a rough token count for a rendered graph string
(4 chars per token heuristic).
